import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Create the DataFrame
data = {
    'amount': [115.02, 44.37, 144.25, 536.22, 38.43],
    'is_fraud': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'transaction_type': ['refund', 'payment', 'transfer', 'payment', 'payment'],
    'hour_of_day': [22, 5, 21, 17, 5]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Set up the matplotlib figure
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))

# Create a boxplot
sns.boxplot(x='transaction_type', y='amount', data=df)

# Add a title and labels
plt.title('Transaction Amounts by Type')
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type')
plt.ylabel('Amount')

# Save the plot as a PNG file
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight')
